text.description_html:
Acorn PS4YP, Dark Green Branches Cabinet Knob

The dark green of this Acorn made cabinet knob is a vibrant reminder of the colors of nature. This ceramic knob features beautiful hand painted designs and just so, each one will be a little different, a little work of art. The Branches Cabinet Knob is 1-7/8" squared. Easy to install, it is a quick way to liven up your kitchen cupboards, your bathroom vanity and your china cabinets.

Features of the Branches Cabinet Knob:

  • Length: 1-7/8" square
  • Material: ceramic
  • Each design is hand painted on ceramic.
  • Package includes 1 knob and hardware for installation.

Sold Individually. Due to the hand painted nature of this product, the colors will vary slightly.
